### Added

- (agent-platform) [Only the annotation marks a namespace's default model](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/3390) by [@QuentinBisson](https://github.com/QuentinBisson) — Customize → Models and a model's page count a model as the default only when it is marked as one; an unmarked `default-model-config` no longer does. Connecting a model marks it the default while none is. Matches agent-manager, which dropped the same rule.
- (muster) [Say connector and use display names in sign-in prompts](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/3384) by [@marians](https://github.com/marians) — Sign-in prompts, the sign-in dialog and the notification inbox say connector and name each one as Customize does, not by its technical name. Starting a session before signing in to Agent Manager offers that sign-in instead of muster's error.

### Fixed

- (backend-common) [Require Node ^24.17.0 so NODE_USE_ENV_PROXY reaches native fetch](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/3388) by [@marians](https://github.com/marians) — For operators: the portal needs Node 24.17.0 or later. With `NODE_USE_ENV_PROXY=1`, the backend refuses to start on a Node whose `fetch` would bypass the egress proxy. The image already runs a newer Node.


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/compare/v3.32.1...v3.33.0
